cases.description: A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext one` underlined with `=` gives `setext-one`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext two` underlined with `-` gives `setext-two`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext three` underlined with `=` gives `setext-three`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext four` underlined with `-` gives `setext-four`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext seven   ` underlined with `=` gives `setext-seven`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `   Setext eight` underlined with `=` gives `setext-eight`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext nine` underlined with `=` gives `setext-nine`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `` Setext *ten* and `code` `` underlined with `-` gives `setext-ten-and-code`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext thirteen, with: punct!` underlined with `=` gives `setext-thirteen-with-punct`.

A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext fourteen ` underlined with `=` gives `setext-fourteen`; GitHub gives `setext-fourteen-`, since it keeps the space next to the anchor element (decision C13).
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext fünfzehn` underlined with `=` gives `setext-fünfzehn`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext sixteen ##` underlined with `=` gives `setext-sixteen-`.
A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `\# Setext seventeen` underlined with `=` gives `-setext-seventeen`.

A setext heading gives the slug of its text, as an ATX heading does: `Setext	eighteen` underlined with `=` gives `setext-eighteen`; GitHub gives `setexteighteen`, since it removes U+0009 rather than turning it into a hyphen.
